headline: Review and vote on FY27 grant applications, including disqualifications, non-grant funding, scoring, and rankings.
summary: The meeting covers FY27 grant applications. Members will confirm disqualified applications and non-grant funding, review scores and rankings, and vote on the final list of approved grants.
items: Confirm applications disqualified for not meeting criteria or requirements
Confirm non-grant funding for Council Program and/or administrative expenses
Review scoring for all other applications
Continue reviewing rankings and available funding, if needed
Vote on final list of approved grants and funding amount for each one
location: Malden City Hall, Room 105, 215 Pleasant St, Malden, MA
